title: SolutionFlow rapid-onramp deck: annotated console walkthrough and modular screenshot kit
creator: Liam Chen
description:
Create a modular, production-ready set of visuals for the SolutionFlow rapid onramp deck used by Sales and Solutions teams. This ticket covers: capturing high-fidelity console screenshots across key flows, annotating UI elements for narrative decks, generating variant crops and aspect ratios (16:9, 4:3, 1:1) for slides and social, producing mobile-stacked comps for solution briefs, and exporting a developer-friendly asset package (SVG overlays, export specs, and token information).

Goals:
- Provide a visual kit that enables Sales to show a concise 3-step onramp (Create, Deploy, Observe) with real product screenshots and callouts.
- Ensure assets meet brand and accessibility guidelines (AA contrast where callouts overlay UI).
- Deliver both editable Figma frames and flattened PNG/JPEG exports optimized for presentations and email templates.

Out of scope: custom illustration work beyond simple UI highlight overlays; videos are a separate follow-up ticket.

Capture checklist (high level):
- Staging console URL: capture flows on staging with demo account, ensure no PII.
- Flows to capture: onboarding flow (API key + quickstart snippet), model selection modal, routing & rollout config, per-route cost/latency dashboard, and export-ready embed card.
- Annotation types: numbered step callouts, short microcopy (6–10 words), and 1–2 result callouts for metric highlights.
- Export specs: 3000px wide for 16:9 master, 1600px for 4:3, 1200px for mobile; provide 2x retina thumbnails.

Hand-off expectations:
- Figma file with named frames and a copyable component library (screenshot-frame, callout-pin, overlay-gradient).
- Drive folder with final PNG/JPEGs, a single ZIP with SVG overlays, a README with export specs and usage guidance, and links to the related PRD.

Accessibility note: ensure callout color choices meet WCAG AA on top of both light and dark console themes. If color contrast fails for any overlay, provide alternate pattern (stroked box + semi-opaque backdrop).
deliverables: Figma: SolutionFlow Rapid Onramp Kit (editable frames and components)
SVG overlay pack and export README
One-slide demo deck with annotated walkthrough (PDF)
Handoff note for Sales with usage do/don't examples
